lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately 12-14 vertical columns extending from the post-branchial region to the caudal peduncle. lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular spot nodes, creating a grid-like arrangement across the primary lateral flank.
